# `servers` — `/api/servers`

Servers router — the model servers chat can use (Ollama or OpenAI-compatible): register, edit and ping them, list each one's models, and remember the default. Tokens stay on the backend; the page sees only has_token.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/servers`](#get-api-servers) | Return all registered Ollama/OpenAI servers (tokens left out). |
| POST | [`/api/servers`](#post-api-servers) | Register a new model server and return the created row. |
| GET | [`/api/servers/default`](#get-api-servers-default) | The server chat uses until the owner picks another: their last choice, an installer's preset endpoint, or Local Ollama. |
| PUT | [`/api/servers/default`](#put-api-servers-default) | Remember the server chat uses, across launches. |
| GET | [`/api/servers/{server_id}`](#get-api-servers-server-id) | Fetch a single server record by ID. |
| PATCH | [`/api/servers/{server_id}`](#patch-api-servers-server-id) | Update non-null fields on a server record. |
| DELETE | [`/api/servers/{server_id}`](#delete-api-servers-server-id) | Remove a server record. |
| GET | [`/api/servers/{server_id}/models`](#get-api-servers-server-id-models) | {models: [{name, ...}]} from any registered server: Ollama's /api/tags, or an OpenAI-compatible /v1/models (ids become names). |
| GET | [`/api/servers/{server_id}/ping`](#get-api-servers-server-id-ping) | Probe a registered server and return its online status. |

<a id="get-api-servers"></a>
### `GET /api/servers`

Return all registered Ollama/OpenAI servers (tokens left out).

- Handler: [`list_servers`](../../../backend/routers/servers.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- `200`: JSON list, each item a row of `servers`: `id`, `name`, `host`, `port`, `type`, `enabled`, `created_at`, `context_window`, `tools_mode`, `model`, plus `has_token`

<a id="post-api-servers"></a>
### `POST /api/servers`

Register a new model server and return the created row.

- Handler: [`create_server`](../../../backend/routers/servers.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `ServerCreate`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `host` | string | yes |  |  |
| `port` | integer | no | `11434` |  |
| `type` | string | no | `"ollama"` |  |
| `auth_token` | string or null | no |  |  |
| `context_window` | integer | no | `8192` | ≥ 2048; ≤ 1048576 |
| `tools_mode` | one of `"native"`, `"text_json"`, `"none"` | no | `"native"` |  |
| `model` | string or null | no |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: a row of `servers`: `id`, `name`, `host`, `port`, `type`, `enabled`, `created_at`, `context_window`, `tools_mode`, `model`, plus `has_token`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

<a id="get-api-servers-default"></a>
### `GET /api/servers/default`

The server chat uses until the owner picks another: their last choice, an installer's preset endpoint, or Local Ollama. Falls back to the first enabled server when the saved one is gone or disabled.

- Handler: [`get_default_server`](../../../backend/routers/servers.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `server` (a row of `servers`: `id`, `name`, `host`, `port`, `type`, `enabled`, `created_at`, `context_window`, `tools_mode`, `model`, plus `has_token`, or `null`)

<a id="put-api-servers-default"></a>
### `PUT /api/servers/default`

Remember the server chat uses, across launches.

- Handler: [`put_default_server`](../../../backend/routers/servers.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `DefaultServer`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `server_id` | integer | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `server` (a database row, plus `has_token`)

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | That server is disabled | `put_default_server` |
| 404 | Server not found | `_get_server` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
